title: radiation.scaffold_contract/1 — Scaffolding Contract Spine
description: Typed sidecar contract per scaffold file under scaffolding/**. P-16 G4: scaffold files get typed sidecar contracts + deterministic compile check. Fields id,file,kind, status, loads_when, depends_on, effects, tests, note?, superseded_by? — contract describes, never rewrites. MEM-shrine-log is a deliberate outer-corpus pointer (docs/shrine/LOG.md — Commander heartbeat record); all other catalog paths MUST live under Brain/.

id.description: unique id SCAFFOLD-<kind>-<slug>, sorted, unique across corpus

file.description: existing scaffold file path relative to repo root, must exist

kind.description: kind of scaffold: core=core forms/procs, neuron=relay records, membrane=control_plane/hosts boundary, other=README/generated/improved etc

status.description: active=live, draft=proposed needs note, deprecated=retired needs superseded_by

loads_when.description: condition when scaffold loads, or null if always/unspecified

depends_on.description: array of contract ids this scaffold depends on, must resolve, no cycles

note.description: optional note, required if status draft

superseded_by.description: required if status deprecated, id of contract that supersedes this
